body.objective: Replace the obstructed unweighted full-time Sobolev realization by the mathematically appropriate compact-Cauchy Weyl-Maxwell constraint-map problem and prove its Fredholm/linearization-stability gate or identify the first exact elliptic obstruction.
body.stop_condition: Import EINSTEIN_MAXWELL_WEYL_SOBOLEV_LINEARIZATION_STABILITY_GATE_V1 and the complete finite exponential-polynomial tangent-cone inputs by exact hashes. On the fixed magnetic-bundle compact Cauchy slice S1 x S2, derive from the Weyl-Maxwell action the complete higher-derivative initial-data and constraint map, including auxiliary/Ostrogradsky variables only when action-equivalent, local Diff/Weyl/Maxwell gauge directions, global charge fibres and the five stabilizers. Choose explicit Sobolev indices and a complete local gauge slice. Compute the Douglis-Nirenberg weighted principal symbol of the constraint-plus-gauge operator and prove ellipticity modulo the declared finite stabilizer, or give an exact characteristic covector/kernel witness disproving it. If elliptic, prove boundedness, closed range and Fredholmness; construct the adjoint kernel and show whether it is exactly the five lifted H, P_x and J_i covectors; establish the smooth/tame mapping estimates needed for the constraint map and quadratic source; and then prove the local momentum-map cone normal form or stop at the first failed hypothesis. Relate the resulting Sobolev tangent cone exactly to the finite-harmonic exponential-polynomial theorem without using density as surjectivity. Land the full operator/symbol ledger, assumptions, functional-analytic proof dossier, independently generated symbol/rank verifier, decisive gauge/weight mutations, receipt, residual-atlas fragment and Paper 13 claim update.
